title: A Summer of Building Something of My Own
subtitle: Entrepreneurship, software & engineering
paragraphs: I spent much of this summer exploring what it means to build a business around engineering.
I began taking on client work and learning how to find opportunities, communicate technical ideas, manage expectations, and deliver something useful.

On the technical side, I’ve been working across embedded systems, C++, connected devices, cloud infrastructure, and software development. I can’t share much about the projects yet, but they’ve given me a better appreciation for building reliable systems outside a classroom.
There has been a lot of learning as I go, especially on the business side. It’s been rewarding to work on something of my own and see where it leads.
